sources.title: Leaving the flat
pages:
Lease of a furnished flat

Article 7. Notice. The tenant may end the lease at any time with one month’s notice, sent by registered letter or handed over against a receipt.
Article 9. Deposit. The deposit of one month’s rent is returned within one month of the keys being handed back, less the cost of any repairs.
sources.ask: How much notice do I give to leave, and when do I get my deposit back?
sources.answer:
Here is what your lease says:

- **Notice:** one month, by registered letter or handed over against a receipt [1].
- **Deposit:** back within a month of handing back the keys, less the cost of any repairs [1].

So if you send the letter today, you can leave in a month.
